claim: Using autonomous AI agents that can reason, plan, and collaborate accelerates DMTA cycles while maintaining scientific rigor.
falsifier: One could implement a comparable multi-agent system for DMTA cycles and measure cycle time and scientific rigor (e.g., number of invalid compounds) with and without the agent system under controlled conditions.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported multi-agent system (Tippy) and its simulated DMTA workflow; transfer to other systems or real-world settings is unestablished.

title: Autonomous AI agents for acceleration of DMTA cycles
